items.sentence: Today, the soup tasted rather salty for the hungry little fox.
Students draw a straight line beside two parallel lines.
Today, the bread baked; meanwhile, the soup simmered on the stove.
One continuous stream of water fell from the mossy rocks.
Today, it was an ordinary morning until the balloons appeared.
Today, the gentle relationship between the dog and cat grew stronger.
Today, warm honey tea soothed the singing bird's sore throat.
Hikers sometimes encounter friendly deer close to the quiet mountain stream.
Kindly do not disturb the sleeping bear in the cave.
Today, the oldest goose will lead the flock toward warm lakes.
